## What's changed

- Fix Wi-Fi always appearing disabled in the control center. Remove conflicting QML registration annotations so Qt can construct the Wi-Fi controller and Bluetooth pairing singletons, expose their properties and methods, and deliver state updates to the UI.
- Close Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and power detail popups whenever the control center closes or another page opens. The window now closes its own popup shells before provider cleanup, so a backend cleanup error cannot leave popups open. Release the popup content and provider after the closing animation.
- Reset the power popup state alongside Wi-Fi and Bluetooth when closing the control center.
- Add regression coverage for declarative singleton registration, Wi-Fi state changes in QML, popup closing and unloading, reopening, page switching, and cleanup failures.

## Validation

- Release build and all 15 CTest suites pass.
- The real Quickshell components pass 11 lifecycle checks on an isolated D-Bus with a fake NetworkManager, without displaying a window or changing the machine's Wi-Fi or Bluetooth state.
- The installed backend reports the actual NetworkManager state correctly, and opening and closing the installed control center produces no related QML runtime errors.

## Installation

Arch Linux / AUR:

```sh
paru -Syu tide-island
```

For a source installation, download `tide-island-source.tar.xz` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the checksum, extract the source, and run `./install.sh`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/enhaoswen/Tide-island/compare/1.0.42...1.0.43
